description: WANDa health check: a review-only, warning-only set per region folder, one row per model and DMA, keyed by names (model name + GIS set + DMA). v0 (basis start) files the build-time model-vs-GIS compare that PLDR builds already compute. Every app reads the newest set for its models; a missing set = 'no health check available'. Never feeds scores or plans, never refuses an app. Not a delivery schema: written only by wanda_import health.

fields.risk_rules: the risk_rules block below as used
fields.projects: [{model_name, model_name_ok (wanda_names rule; false = name fails the rule), project_id, project_version, folder_rel, gis_set, models_set, built_at, status (ok | skipped: <why>), left_out_dmas (count), left_out_dma_refs, sources: {source: found true / false; incl. gis_valves and facility_topology_flow}}]

fields.gis: the gis set name the check used: wanda_client check reports STALE when a newer GIS set is filed

risk_rules.rule: risk = highest default_risk of the row's facts (none < low < medium < high); no facts = none

types.ref: text exactly as recorded; never changed
types.code: a code from the field's code list

dma_health.description: One row per model and kept DMA (see rows_rule), plus one model row (blank dma_ref) per model. File dma_health.csv, header = the field names in this order; v1 columns are appended after risk_reasons.

fields.name: model_name
fields.description: Model name (wanda_names rule <area>_<version>_Model), as the PLDR project records it

fields.name: gis_set
fields.description: The GIS set this health check is against: the newest finished inputs\gis set in the region folder when the check ran (blank region GIS: the project's build GIS set)

fields.name: dma_ref
fields.description: DMA reference as in the GIS; blank = the model row (one per model, see rows_rule)

fields.name: build_gis_set
fields.description: The GIS set the project was built on (pldr_project.json inputs_from.gis)

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: PLDR project id

fields.name: project_version
fields.description: PLDR project version number (the live version)

fields.name: models_set
fields.description: The models set the project was built from (pldr_project.json inputs_from.models)

fields.name: built_at
fields.description: When the project raw build completed (last project_raw_build complete in the build log)

fields.name: basis
fields.description: start = build-time model-vs-GIS compare (v0); change = GIS change log against the previous extract (v1)

fields.name: model_coverage
fields.description: How far the model covers the DMA (model on the model row); not PLDR's dma_state

fields.name: gis_pipes
fields.description: GIS pipes in the DMA in the project's GIS (model row: kept DMA rows + linked GIS mains with no DMA)

fields.name: linked_pipes
fields.description: Of those, GIS pipes linked to a model pipe

fields.name: pipe_link_pct
fields.description: linked_pipes / gis_pipes x 100, one decimal (= the PLDR regional ranking model coverage)

fields.name: gis_length_m
fields.description: GIS pipe length in the DMA (model row: as gis_pipes)

fields.name: modelled_length_m
fields.description: Length of the DMA's GIS pipes linked to the model

fields.name: length_pct
fields.description: modelled_length_m / gis_length_m x 100, one decimal

fields.name: trace_status
fields.description: PLDR trace readiness tier as the build recorded it (dma_trace_readiness.trace_status: pass, pass_multi_inlet, warning, blocked, no_customers); blank = not evaluated

fields.name: trace_coverage_pct
fields.description: Share of the DMA's customers the trace reaches

fields.name: model_pipes
fields.description: Model row only: model pipes in the project's model

fields.name: model_pipes_linked
fields.description: Model row only: model pipes linked to at least one GIS pipe

fields.name: spatial_rejected
fields.description: Spatial (geometry) links the build refused (model row: kept DMA rows + no DMA)

fields.name: linked_mains_no_dma
fields.description: Model row only: GIS mains linked to the model with no DMA in the GIS

fields.name: valves_shut
fields.description: GIS isolation valves (gis_valves is_gate_valve = 1) in the DMA whose normal position is shut (C / CLOSED, trimmed, any case); a boundary valve counts in its GIS dma_ref only (model row: kept DMA rows + isolation valves with no DMA)

fields.name: valves_open
fields.description: GIS isolation valves in the DMA that are not shut (O, T, U or blank) (model row: as valves_shut)

fields.name: valves_not_in_model
fields.description: Of the DMA's GIS isolation valves, those with no Valves row of the same name (trimmed valve_ref) in the model baseline FacilityTopology_Flow.csv; column only in v0 (no fact); blank = no baseline CSV

fields.name: valves_shut_model_flows
fields.description: GIS isolation valves shut in the GIS whose model valve carries flow at 24:00 (abs FacilityFlow >= risk_rules.model_flow_min_ls): open in the model for certain; blank = no baseline CSV

fields.name: valves_open_model_no_flow
fields.description: GIS isolation valves open in the GIS whose model valve carries no flow at 24:00 (shut in the model, or open and idle: no flow is not proof of shut); blank = no baseline CSV

fields.name: risk_level
fields.description: The one generic risk: the highest default_risk of risk_reasons; none when there are no reasons

fields.name: risk_reasons
fields.description: The health_fact codes found for the row (';' separated); blank = none; readers accept unknown codes

rows_rule: DMA rows = the DMAs PLDR ranks (at least one GIS pipe linked to the model, PLDR pldr_dma_scope.ranking_dmas kept) plus DMAs the build linkage gate puts inside the model extent with no pipe linked (in_extent_not_linked). PLDR leaves every DMA with no pipe linked out of its ranking as not_modelled; health splits PLDR's not-ranked DMAs into in_extent_not_linked (row kept, high) and left out (clip-only: only in the clipped GIS; no row, counted in projects[].left_out_dmas = PLDR's ranking left_out less the in-extent ones). Builds with no linkage gate: every DMA with no pipe linked is left out (as the PLDR ranking does). DMAs are grouped on the trimmed dma_ref (PLDR groups on the raw value then trims: the same unless two refs differ only by spaces). The model row: model-wide facts only, permanently; its GIS counts, lengths and spatial rejects are over the kept DMA rows plus the linked GIS mains with no DMA (one rule for all of them). Valve counts follow the same rule: kept DMA rows plus GIS isolation valves with no DMA; the model row raises a valve fact only for the valves with no DMA (the DMA rows carry their own). Valve evidence (v0) is the model valve FLOW at 24:00 in the project's model_results\baseline\FacilityTopology_Flow.csv (or facility_topology_flow.csv), not the model valve setting, which PLDR does not hold: GIS shut + flow proves the model open; GIS open + no flow may be shut or idle.
reader_rules: Read by header name; ignore columns you do not know (later minor versions append columns after risk_reasons).
Accept health_fact codes you do not know (show the code as is; its risk is already in risk_level).
A row applies to a build only when project_id and project_version match the live PLDR version; otherwise show 'no health check for this build'.
When gis_set differs from build_gis_set show 'built on an older GIS; change not assessed until v1'.
No set, or no row for the model: 'no health check available'. Warning only: never refuse, score or plan on it.

v1 key rule: start and change merge into one row per (model_name, gis_set, dma_ref); basis = the row's latest basis. v1 may add a separate worst_dma_risk column on the model row; the model row's own risk stays model-wide facts.
